title: test: PIV BER parser with valid tag but truncated value
description: wp11_proto_piv.c BER/TLV parsing is tested for wrong tags and overflowing values, but not for a response that claims a large length (e.g., 0x82 0x01 0x00 = 256 bytes) but delivers fewer bytes than declared. The parser should return WP11_PIV_ERR_ENCODING or WP11_PIV_ERR_TRUNCATED, not read out-of-bounds. Add a unit test in wp11_test_piv.c injecting a response buffer where the BER length field exceeds the actual buffer size.
